controls.title: Inventory and classify sensitive data
controls.statement: Identify sensitive data, assign accountable owners and apply a maintained classification scheme that drives handling, retention and protection decisions.
controls.risk: Sensitive information that is unknown or incorrectly classified can be stored, shared or retained without the protection expected by the organisation and its stakeholders.
controls.scope: Information processed, stored or transmitted by enterprise systems, cloud services, endpoints and third parties.
controls.examine: Review the data-management process, inventory, ownership records, classification scheme, labels, retention rules and links to system security categorisation.
controls.interview: Ask data and system owners how new data sets are discovered, classified and reclassified and how handling requirements reach users and technology controls.
controls.test: Sample sensitive data from systems and inventories in both directions and verify ownership, classification, location, handling and retention requirements.
test_steps: Select sensitive data discovered in endpoints, repositories, databases, cloud services and transfer platforms, plus records from the authoritative data inventory.
Reconcile observed data to inventory entries and listed holdings to a current location, confirming owner, classification, purpose, users and retention.
Apply the classification decision rules independently to sampled records and compare the result with labels and handling controls actually applied.
Introduce an authorised labelled test record and verify downstream copies, exports and retention actions preserve or appropriately translate its classification.
controls.expected: Sampled sensitive data is present in the inventory, has an accountable owner and classification, and is handled according to current documented requirements.

mappings.basis: Requires a data-management process covering sensitivity, ownership, handling, retention and disposal.
Requires a maintained inventory that includes sensitive data at a minimum.
Requires a maintained enterprise data-classification scheme.
Requires categorisation of systems and the information they process, store and transmit with documented approval.
Describes progressively defined, automated and enterprise-wide data categorisation and labelling.
Classifies equipment by the highest data sensitivity it is approved to handle.

controls.title: Protect data at rest and in transit
controls.statement: Apply protection, including appropriate cryptography, to sensitive data while it is stored and while it moves between people, systems and organisations.
controls.risk: Sensitive information can be read or altered after a device, storage service or communication path is compromised.
controls.scope: Sensitive data in databases, applications, endpoints, backups, removable storage, networks, interfaces and third-party services.
controls.examine: Compare the data inventory and classifications with encryption standards, architecture, configurations, key ownership, exceptions and coverage reports.
controls.interview: Ask data, platform and security owners how protection requirements are translated into storage and transmission controls and how exceptions are approved.
controls.test: Sample sensitive data stores and transmission paths and verify effective protection, approved algorithms and controlled handling of any plaintext exposure.
test_steps: Choose sensitive datasets across endpoints, servers, databases, backups, cloud storage, APIs, email and network transfer paths.
Inspect effective encryption, key ownership and access settings at rest, then observe representative transfers to confirm protected protocols and certificate validation.
Attempt an authorised connection using a prohibited protocol or untrusted certificate and verify rejection without downgrade or plaintext fallback.
Search controlled logs, temporary files and processing locations for the test data and record any unexpected plaintext exposure or uncontrolled copy.
controls.expected: Sampled sensitive data is protected in storage and transit according to its classification, with justified and approved exceptions.

mappings.basis: Requires encryption of sensitive data in transit.
Requires encryption of sensitive data at rest on servers, applications and databases.
Requires protection of confidentiality or integrity for transmitted information.
Requires protection of confidentiality or integrity for organisation-defined information at rest.
Requires cryptographic controls for selected data categories at rest and in transit.
Describes maturity progression toward enterprise encryption at rest and in transit with managed keys.

controls.title: Restrict unauthorised data movement
controls.statement: Control and monitor sensitive-data flows across systems, networks, endpoints and service providers to prevent unauthorised disclosure or exfiltration.
controls.risk: Sensitive information can leave the organisation through an approved connection, compromised account or unmanaged service without being blocked or detected.
controls.scope: Sensitive-data transfers through email, web, cloud, removable media, interfaces, managed devices and connected systems.
controls.examine: Review approved information-flow policies, architecture, data-loss controls, monitored channels, alerts, exceptions and investigations.
controls.interview: Ask data and security owners which movement is permitted, how controls recognise sensitive information and how blocked or suspicious transfers are handled.
controls.test: Use authorised test data to verify representative permitted and prohibited flows, alert generation and investigation across major transfer channels.
test_steps: Create uniquely marked, non-sensitive test data representing relevant classifications and define permitted and prohibited destinations for each transfer channel.
Send permitted test transfers through email, web, removable media, cloud sharing and other major channels and verify normal business flow and correct audit records.
Attempt prohibited transfers using straightforward and mildly altered forms such as archive, rename or copy-paste, staying within the authorised test plan.
Confirm prevention or alerting, trace the event to a timely investigation with user and destination context, and remove all test data from recipients and queues.
controls.expected: Authorised flows operate as designed while prohibited or suspicious movement of sensitive data is blocked or detected and investigated.

mappings.basis: Requires controls that restrict data exfiltration, including data-loss prevention tools.
Requires controls that restrict data exfiltration, including data-loss prevention tools.
Requires enforcement of approved authorisations controlling information flow within and between systems.
Requires an automated data-loss prevention tool to identify sensitive data across enterprise assets and service providers.
